name: cloze
description: Access contacts, relationships, and real estate deals in your connected Cloze account.

interface.longDescription:
Cloze is the AI-powered real estate platform that helps agents and brokerages get more revenue from every relationship. Cloze uses your emails, calls, texts, and the tools you already use to find forgotten clients, leads about to go cold, and active clients that need follow up. Cloze connects to more than 200 tools, including Gmail, Outlook, SkySlope, Canva, MAXA, HomeSpotter, and more.

The Cloze plugin brings that work into ChatGPT. Get ready for a client call, log a note after a showing, write a follow-up, or make marketing for a new listing without switching apps. Answers come from your own Cloze records.

In ChatGPT, you can:
• Look up contacts and deals, or find past clients you haven’t talked to in a while
• Get a quick summary of a client’s history before a call or meeting
• Add contacts, notes, and to-dos, and update tags, stages, and contact details
• Write and send a personal follow-up email
• Create Canva flyers and social posts pre-filled with your listing details and branding
• Create a listing presentation, or send a property or client to HomeSpotter or RealScout for marketing

Agents, team leads, and brokerage leaders each work with the records their own Cloze account can see. Personal contacts stay private to each agent.
capabilities: Summarize notes, communication history, and activity for people and listings in Cloze
Access information about your profile and business
Connect to integrated tools like Canva, Cloud CMA, HomeSpotter, MAXA, RealScout, and more
defaultPrompt: Draft an email to Jane McKittrick introducing me as a local real estate agent
Find everyone in Cloze tagged as Past Client that I haven't communicated with recently
Create a Canva flyer for the Oakwood Heights property

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

positive.description: Catch up on a client before a call
positive.prompt: Catch me up on my recent emails and notes with Gina Harris before I call her..
positive.expected_behavior: Summarizes recent timeline items for Gina from the test account.

positive.prompt: how many people have the location tag?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the number of people with the location tag (29 in the test account currently).

positive.prompt: Remind me to call Dana Varenos next Tuesday.
positive.expected_behavior: Find the contact and logs a ToDo on her timeline.

positive.prompt: Draft a check-in email to Louis Tully.
positive.expected_behavior: Drafts an email to the contact using past conversations as input.

positive.prompt: Add Sarah Johnson to my contacts. Her email is sarah.johnson@example.org.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates the contact if it doesn't already exist.

negative.prompt: send the email I just drafted.

negative.description: You cannot access other user's contacts
negative.prompt: Show me all the contacts in Jane Doe's Cloze account

publication.release_notes: First release. Look up contacts, deals, and client history in Cloze. Add notes, to-dos, contacts, and deals. Update contact and deal details. Save email drafts to Cloze for review.
